text: Edward Braunstein for Assembly – Edward Braunstein Is Standing Up For Us And Will Continue Protect, Fight and Champion for what is Right!

I grew up in Bayside and am bringing up my three kids here. Eastern Queens has always been a great place to live and raise a family, and we want to keep it that way. That’s why in Albany I have been fighting to make New York more affordable, keep our communities safe, and make sure our children have access to a quality education.
In the State Assembly, Edward Braunstein is fighting hard every day to ensure Eastern Queens is safe and affordable.
Edward Braunstein’s Record of Fighting for Queens Families
Delivered energy and inflation rebate checks
Enacted legislation to lower auto insurance rates
Passed a moratorium on new data center construction
Secured some of the strongest gun safety laws in the country
Empowered judges and prosecutors with more discretion to hold violent criminals and repeat offenders accountable
Voted for universal pre-K and historic child tax credits
Strongly supported New York City’s Specialized High School Admissions Test and Gifted and Talented program
In the State Assembly, Edward Braunstein
is Fighting to Make Our Communities Safer and More Affordable
